english.title: Male 21 years or over commit buggery with male between 16 and 20 years with consent
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a man of or over the age of 21, committed buggery with **(..SPECIFY NAME..), a man under the age of 21, namely of the age of **(..SPECIFY AGE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 12(1) of the Sexual Offences Act 1956.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and location
male person of or over 21 years of age
commit buggery with a male person aged 16 to 21 years of age with consent

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This offence became OBSOLETE from 03/11/1994.

Consent of DPP required for buggery between two males where either is under age twenty-one.MOPI RETENTION: Review the offence record and retain in line with its modern equivalent. Where both parties are over 18 this is not an offence, so MoPI 4 applies. If one party was under 18, MoPI 2 offences might apply (eg: abuse of position of trust or family member).No longer an offence/no modern equivalent.
